meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 变成发布经理:触发 GitHub Actions 的 publish 工作流把 oh-my-opencode 发到 npm,再逐个核对 npm 版本、GitHub release、Discord 公告等发布面。
howto.when: 当你说 “publish”、“release” 等关键词,或要发补丁/小版本/大版本时接管;未给出版本选择器会先停下询问。

say.note: 触发工作流发布补丁版本
发布向后兼容的新功能版本
按指定语义化版本发布

howto.what_en: After install, Claude acts as release manager: it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow to ship oh-my-opencode to npm, then verifies the npm version, GitHub release, Discord announcement and other release surfaces.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “publish”, “release” etc., or ask for a patch, minor, or major bump; if no release selector is given it stops and asks first.

say_en.note: Triggers the workflow for a patch release
